products.name: Leion Delivery Founding Pilot
products.notes:
Produit initialise directement depuis le cockpit.

Audience: Agencies and software factories with repeated GitHub delivery work.
Probleme: Repeated GitHub delivery work stays manual, opaque, and hard to govern.
Promesse: Turn issue-to-PR, PR fix, and release gates into governed AI workflows with explicit human approval.

offer.name: Leion Delivery Founding Pilot
offer.audience: Agencies and software factories with repeated GitHub delivery work.
offer.problem: Repeated GitHub delivery work stays manual, opaque, and hard to govern.
offer.promise: Turn issue-to-PR, PR fix, and release gates into governed AI workflows with explicit human approval.
offer.proof: Show 3 delivery flows running on one repo with traceable approvals and reusable run history.
offer.callToAction: Book a 30-minute pilot scoping call on one target repository.

funnel.acquisition: Prospection fondateur ciblee sur agencies and software factories with repeated github delivery work..
funnel.qualification: Valider que le prospect vit bien repeated github delivery work stays manual, opaque, and hard to govern..
funnel.demo: Montrer une interface dediee + 1 a 3 pipelines pour Leion Delivery Founding Pilot.
funnel.proposal: Transformer la promesse "Turn issue-to-PR, PR fix, and release gates into governed AI workflows with explicit human approval." en pilote payable.
funnel.close: Convertir le pilote en abonnement mensuel autour de Leion Delivery Founding Pilot.

templates.name: Founder outbound email
templates.subject: Leion Delivery Founding Pilot pour equipes avec repeated github delivery work stays manual, opaque, and hard to govern.
templates.body:
Bonjour {{name}},

je travaille sur Leion Delivery Founding Pilot.

Le probleme que je cible est simple: Repeated GitHub delivery work stays manual, opaque, and hard to govern.
La promesse: Turn issue-to-PR, PR fix, and release gates into governed AI workflows with explicit human approval.

Si c est pertinent pour votre equipe, je peux te montrer le cockpit et le flow en demo tres concrete.

Matth

templates.name: LinkedIn follow-up
templates.body:
Bonjour {{name}},
je reviens vers toi au sujet de Leion Delivery.
On aide les equipes a standardiser issue -> PR, PR fix et release gate avec validation humaine explicite.
Si tu veux, je peux te montrer le flow sur un repo de demo.

providerAccounts.label: Gmail
providerAccounts.notes:
[Gmail OAuth]
Flow: desktop OAuth with loopback callback and PKCE.
Scopes: OpenID, Gmail drafts and send, https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.email, https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.profile, https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file.
Mode: draft-first and manual-first. No blind auto-send.

providerAccounts.label: Google Workspace
providerAccounts.notes:
[Google OAuth]
Flow: desktop OAuth with loopback callback and PKCE.
Scopes: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.profile, https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.email, OpenID, Google Drive (file-level), Google Sheets.
Surface: Google Sheets and Drive first. Gmail comes next as a separate connector.
providerAccounts.lastValidationMessage: Google Sheet creee depuis le cockpit.
